title: Convert to CBZ
description: Batch convert PDF/ePub files to CBZ archives.

options.description: Input directory, scanned recursively; required without an interactive terminal.
Output root; default: <input>/.output. Relative directories are preserved.
Replace an existing target only after validating a partial archive; default: skip existing targets.
Rendered PDF page format; default: jpg.
Concurrent files; default: min(4, NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS), or 4 when unavailable.
Legacy accepted setting; default: 1. EPUB extraction uses --concurrency, with no separate EPUB limit.

notes: PDF conversion requires Poppler: pdfinfo, pdfimages, and pdftoppm.
Fixed-layout EPUB pages preserve source JPEG/PNG/WebP bytes in reading order; text-only EPUBs are unsupported.
Native PDF scans are extracted when possible; format, quality, and DPI apply to rendered pages.
